questions.question: Bal Gangadhar Tilak is most closely associated with which faction of the Indian National Congress?
Which state approved a proposal on June 19, 2025, to raise minority reservation in housing schemes to 15%?
India's Fourth Five-year plan was started in which year?
Who gave permission to Sri Lankan Ruler to build the Buddhist temple at Gaya?
Which crops of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds were primarily introduced during the Green Revolution in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Wheat and rice) है।

questions.question: According to the Indian Constitution, if Money Bill is rejected by the Lok Sabha, then as a consequence __________.
options: the Government introduces a new Money Bill
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (the Government will step down) है।

questions.question: In which state is the Gosikhurd Irrigation Project located?
Which of the following Acts assigned residuary powers exclusively to the Viceroy of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Government of India Act, 1935) है।

questions.question: In uniform circular motion, why does the centripetal force do no work on the body?
options: Because the force is always perpendicular to the displacement
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Because the force is always perpendicular to the displacement) है।

questions.question: Which of the following states has tropical thorn forests?
Which famous musician is known for popularising the tabla globally?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Ustad Zakir Hussain) है।

questions.question: Name the Sultan of Delhi whose eldest son died in the Mongol invasion.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Ghiyas ud din Balban) है।

questions.question: Who became India's 85th Chess Grandmaster in 2024?
Who among the following was appointed as the chairperson of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) in August 2023?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Justice Prakash Shrivastava) है।

questions.question: The state of Uttarakhand won the best Tableaux award based on the theme of _______ during the Republic Day parade in 2023.
